data.title: 中野一花 · 雨夜林间仓库的避雨独处
data.description: 深山仓库外暴雨倾盆，柴火堆旁摇曳着橘暖的火光。微带倦意的一花席地靠在木箱旁，双手环抱膝盖，目光柔和地倾听着身边少年的呼吸。
data.action: sitting on hay bale, warming hands near fire, gentle blush
data.promptProse: Inside a rustic log warehouse during a heavy rainstorm, Nakano Ichika sits beside a cozy flickering campfire on a bed of hay. Her pink short hair is slightly damp from the rain, and she warms her hands over the fire with an introspective, gentle blush.
data.animaCaption: Sitting by the cozy hearth in the rain-sheltered wooden barn, she looks up with flushed cheeks.
